pages.text: $(bold)Create Big Cannons$(): cast or build cannons block by block, mount them, load them, aim with a controller or a contraption. Autocannons for defence, big guns for sieges.$(br2)$(bold)Tier 3$(): Maledictus, in the Frosted Prison, holds the knowledge.
A mount turns a cannon into a turret. Cannons on a ship or a train are contraptions like any other.

$(bold)Server rules:$() shells hurt $(bold)mobs and players$() in their blast but $(bold)do not break blocks$(). You can defend a town and fight a ship; you cannot level a town. Explosions from cannons are AOE only.$(br2)Muskets are the handheld cousins and follow the Blasting Blueprint, not this one.
